conditions.title: Back and neck pain, including sciatica
conditions.plainSummary: Persistent or flare-up pain in your back or neck, sometimes travelling down an arm or leg.
conditions.whatWeAssess: How you move, where movement is limited, and whether nerve symptoms like tingling or numbness are present.
conditions.typicalApproach: Hands-on treatment alongside a graded exercise programme to build strength and confidence in movement again.

conditions.title: Shoulder problems, including frozen shoulder
conditions.plainSummary: Pain, stiffness or weakness that makes reaching, lifting or sleeping on that side difficult.
conditions.whatWeAssess: Your shoulder's range of movement, strength and the pattern of pain, to work out what's driving it.
conditions.typicalApproach: A staged plan of manual therapy and targeted exercise, paced to how your shoulder is responding.

conditions.title: Tennis elbow and golfer's elbow
conditions.plainSummary: Pain on the outside or inside of the elbow, often worse when gripping or lifting.
conditions.whatWeAssess: Which tendons are irritated, and what everyday movements or grips are keeping it flared up.
conditions.typicalApproach: Loading exercises to build tendon tolerance, plus advice on adapting the activities that aggravate it.

conditions.title: Knee problems
conditions.plainSummary: Pain, swelling or a sense of instability affecting how your knee copes with walking, stairs or sport.
conditions.whatWeAssess: Knee alignment, muscle control around the joint, and how it behaves under load.
conditions.typicalApproach: A structured strengthening programme, often alongside manual therapy to ease pain in the early stages.

conditions.title: Hip problems
conditions.plainSummary: Groin, buttock or outer-hip pain that limits walking distance, sitting or sleeping position.
conditions.whatWeAssess: Hip and pelvis movement, muscle strength, and how the hip relates to your back and knee.
conditions.typicalApproach: Manual therapy for early relief, moving into a hip and pelvis strengthening programme.

conditions.title: Ankle and foot problems
conditions.plainSummary: Sprains, persistent ankle pain, or foot pain that changes how you walk or run.
conditions.whatWeAssess: Ankle stability, foot mechanics and balance, particularly after a sprain or repeated niggles.
conditions.typicalApproach: Balance and strengthening work to rebuild stability, alongside hands-on treatment where needed.

conditions.title: Sports injuries
conditions.plainSummary: Muscle strains, ligament sprains and overuse injuries from running, gym training or team sport.
conditions.whatWeAssess: The injured tissue, your training load, and what's realistic for your return-to-sport timeline.
conditions.typicalApproach: A phased return-to-sport plan combining hands-on treatment with sport-specific strength and conditioning.

conditions.title: Post-surgery rehabilitation
conditions.plainSummary: Regaining movement, strength and confidence after joint or soft-tissue surgery.
conditions.whatWeAssess: Your surgeon's protocol, your current range of movement, and where you are against expected milestones.
conditions.typicalApproach: Guided rehabilitation that follows your surgical protocol, building load gradually as you're cleared to.

conditions.title: Headaches and dizziness (vestibular)
conditions.plainSummary: Headaches linked to neck tension, and dizziness or balance problems affecting daily life.
conditions.whatWeAssess: Neck movement and muscle tension, and — where relevant — balance and eye-movement tests for vestibular symptoms.
conditions.typicalApproach: Manual therapy and specific exercises for neck-related headaches, or a vestibular rehabilitation programme where indicated.

conditions.title: Women's and pelvic health
conditions.plainSummary: Pelvic pain, bladder or core-related concerns, including during and after pregnancy.
conditions.whatWeAssess: Pelvic floor and core function, movement patterns, and what matters most for your daily life or return to exercise.
conditions.typicalApproach: A private, unhurried assessment followed by a tailored exercise and self-management plan.

conditions.title: Arthritis and long-term pain management
conditions.plainSummary: Ongoing joint pain or a long-term pain condition affecting what you can comfortably do.
conditions.whatWeAssess: Which movements and activities are affected, and what's realistic to work towards together.
conditions.typicalApproach: A steady, sustainable exercise and movement plan, adjusted as your symptoms change over time.
